panels.title: Client-side throughput (warp writes cumulative totals; panels use derivative())

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "warp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^${op:regex}$/ and r.warp_id =~ /^${warp_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "requests")
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> yield(name: "rate")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "warp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^${op:regex}$/ and r.warp_id =~ /^${warp_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "bytes_total")
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> yield(name: "rate")

panels.title: Mean request latency (per interval)
panels.description: warp streams only totals, so the mean per interval = Δrequest_total_secs / Δrequests. Percentiles and max are NOT in InfluxDB: take them from `warp analyze` (meta in bench/results) or from the server dashboard (histograms).

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "warp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^${op:regex}$/ and r.warp_id =~ /^${warp_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "request_total_secs" or r._field == "requests")
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint", "_field"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> toFloat()
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, op: r.op, warp_id: r.warp_id, endpoint: r.endpoint,
       _value: if r.requests > 0 then r.request_total_secs / float(v: r.requests) else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> yield(name: "mean_latency")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "warp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^${op:regex}$/ and r.warp_id =~ /^${warp_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "request_ttfb_total_secs" or r._field == "requests")
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint", "_field"])
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> toFloat()
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, op: r.op, warp_id: r.warp_id, endpoint: r.endpoint,
       _value: if r.requests > 0 then r.request_ttfb_total_secs / float(v: r.requests) else 0.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> yield(name: "mean_latency")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "warp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^${op:regex}$/ and r.warp_id =~ /^${warp_id:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "objects")
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)

  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id", "endpoint"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "cumulative")

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^${op:regex}$/ and r.warp_id =~ /^${warp_id:regex}$/)

panels.title: Run summaries (written by warp at the end of each run)
warp_run_summary
panels.description: Per run and operation: totals, and mean/min/max request latency (seconds).

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "warp_run_summary")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^${op:regex}$/ and r.warp_id =~ /^${warp_id:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> toFloat()
  |> group(columns: ["op", "warp_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["op", "warp_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "_time"])
